name: No Quotes 3
description: UofTCTF 2026 / No Quotes 3: User-controlled data reaches a database query through string interpolation, dynamic query construction, or a custom sanitizer instead of strict parameter binding. Injection type is SQL Injection. Attack surface: unauthenticated web parameters, login/search forms, JSON bodies, or API query fields that feed database/query logic. Recommended strategy: The login query is "WHERE username = ('{username}') AND password = ('{password}')" and the WAF rejects single quotes, double quotes and periods. Closing the parenthesis is still allowed, so build string literals without quotes using hex or char-free constructs, and note that the third variant also hashes the password, so the injection must land in the username side and control the whole comparison.
vuln_type: SQL Injection with quote and period blacklist (hash-comparison variant)

Difficulty Medium-Hard (4) because the primitive is blind or heavily filtered and requires an oracle plus a gadget chain. Impact 8.7 because successful exploitation can bypass authentication or extract hidden database rows/flag material.
